name: Veda Parayanam
description: Traditional recitation by trained students and acharyas.
detail: Chanting of sacred Vedic mantras with strict adherence to traditional swara and pronunciation by our acharyas and vidyarthis.

name: Ganapathi Homam
description: Auspicious homam for new beginnings and removal of obstacles.
detail: Invoking Lord Vigneshwara through sacred fire offerings to remove obstacles and bless new undertakings with harmony.

name: Ayush Homam
description: Prayers for health, longevity and wellbeing.
detail: Vedic fire ritual praying for good health, vitality, protection, and long life — especially auspicious on Janma Nakshatram.

name: Navagraha Homam
description: Homam honouring the nine grahas, for balance and peace of mind.
detail: Dedicated ahutis honouring all nine celestial grahas with traditional samit and mantras to restore balance and serenity.

name: Rudra Parayanam
description: Recitation of the Rudram, in full or in part, as advised.
detail: Reverent chanting of Sri Rudra Prashna (Ekadasa Rudram or Namakam-Chamakam) invoking the grace of Lord Parameshwara.

name: Lalitha Sahasranamam Parayanam
description: Recitation of the thousand names, individually or in a group.
detail: Devotional recitation of the thousand sacred names of Devi Lalitha, bringing grace, auspiciousness, and spiritual upliftment.

name: Griha Pravesham Pooja
description: Blessings for a new home, performed at your home or at the gurukulam.
detail: Complete traditional housewarming rites including Punyahavachanam, Ganapathi Pooja, and Vastu blessings for a peaceful home.

name: Shraddham / Tarpanam Guidance
description: Guidance and support for ancestral rites, as per family tradition.
detail: Compassionate, shastra-compliant guidance and priestly support for ancestral rites tailored to your family's Sutra and custom.
